messages:
rachel: quick heads-up for tomorrow's eu-west deploy: trying a 'quietspin' FF strategy for llm-routing v3. idea is tiny initial slice + extended soak + session-keepalive pin for existing sessions. posting runbook for feedback.

deploybot: scheduled window 2026-06-10 22:30 UTC. quietspin plan: steps=0.5,2,10,50,100 with soak=12m each. session-keepalive: pin active sessions to v2 for 50m. safety-shepherd: auto-stepdown on canary regressions and an emergency disable to v2. runbook: `/deploybot ff quietspin --name=llm-routing-v3 --steps=0.5,2,10,50,100 --soak=12m --pin=active_sessions --safety=shepherd:err>1.5%,p95>300ms`

samir: +1 to quietspin. request: deploybot should post cohort counts, 1m/5m error deltas, and GPU util after each step. First step 0.5% only if cohort slicing supports fractional.

sre_oncall: i'll take watch for the first 90m. alerting rules: error-rate increase >1.5% absolute for 4m OR p95 latency >300ms for 5m -> auto-stepdown one level and notify #eng-oncall. emergency: if REQ_ERRORS >3x baseline for 90s -> ff set to 0 and pin rollback cohorts. i'll spin up a temporary dashboard and enable traces.

infra: we'll pre-pin v2 for cohorts:session_pinned,legacy_clients for 1h. pin command: `/infra ff pin --name=llm-routing-v3 --cohorts=session_pinned,legacy_clients --version=v2 --duration=1h`. auto-unpin only after 30m stable at 100% or explicit approval.

product: release note suggestion: "llm-routing v3 quietspin rollout: fractional canary, extended soaks, session-keepalive pins, and automated safety-shepherding." adding runbook snippet to release doc.

samir: ops checklist to add: 1) confirm GPUs <70% before advancing, 2) ensure deploybot EMERG key is reachable, 3) enable request-level traces for 20m after 100%.

sre_oncall: i'll post the dashboard link here once ready and will update metrics at each step during the window. ready to cut if alarms fire.

rachel: rollback procedure: immediate disable via `/deploybot ff set llm-routing-v3 0`, then `/infra ff unpin --name=llm-routing-v3 --cohorts=session_pinned,legacy_clients` validate v2 for 15m before clearing. keeping this thread as Canonical Ops during the window. :white_check_mark:
